_comment: Copy this file to config.local.json (git-ignored) and fill in your instance. Every field can also come from an env var (SEARXNG_BASE_URL, SEARXNG_SSH_HOST, SEARXNG_SSH_USER, SEARXNG_CONTAINER, SEARXNG_SETTINGS_PATH, SEARXNG_VERIFY_SSL, SEARXNG_TIMEOUT), which override the file. The HTTP `base_url` is all you need for search, introspection and diagnostics. The config-management ('tune') tools additionally need `ssh_host` + `container`: they edit settings.yml inside the container over SSH and restart it. Leave ssh_host empty to run in read/search-only mode.
